variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Rat Shot
variants.info:
Loads your gun with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

variants.name: .22 Super Colibri
variants.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with Super Colibri rounds, which are the closest you'll get to a pellet gun with how pathetic the velocity is.
